checks.what: patients in the finger flexion experiment

checks.what: distinct finger codes of the cue
checks.source: readme: cue codes 1-5 = thumb to little finger

checks.source: readme: flex has five columns thumb-index-middle-ring-little

checks.what: stim codes outside the readme list are -1 and -2 only
checks.detail: [np.int64(-2), np.int64(-1), np.int64(0), np.int64(1), np.int64(2), np.int64(3), np.int64(4), np.int64(5)]

differences: The stim variable also holds the codes -1 (about a quarter of the samples in most patients) and -2 (a few patients, few samples), which the readme does not define; they are kept as shared. The cue of one patient is 1 (thumb) for almost the whole session and 0 otherwise, unlike the other patients' cycling cues (the deposit gives no explanation).
Published statistics of the library paper concern ECoG analyses and were not reproduced; the checks are the participant count and the code lists of the readme.
The deposit's other task zips (for example motor_basic, gestures, joystick_track, mouse_track) and the BCI Competition IV version of the finger flexion data were not converted.
